import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@workspace"
dtstamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Workspace//Calendar Skill//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260803T100000
DTEND;TZID=Asia/Shanghai:20260803T120000
SUMMARY:Project Kickoff Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Project kickoff meeting
STATUS:CONFIRMED
TRANSP:OPAQUE
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starting soon
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("project_kickoff.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print("Wrote project_kickoff.ics")
print(ics)
EOF
